implementation_sha: reported in the final gate record; not embedded self-referentially

implementation.persisted_state_authority: One accepted NonlinearState; no trial state is persisted.
implementation.v1_reader: Explicit schema_version=1 detection followed by bounded in-memory migration.
implementation.serialization: Tagged deterministic payload with dtype, shape and C-order bytes; allow_pickle=false.
implementation.digests: deterministic_state_digest is authoritative for six components and the composite state.
implementation.topology: DOF, material integration-point, contact entry and continuation-key topology are validated.
implementation.atomicity: Same-directory temporary NPZ, file fsync where supported, atomic replace, optional POSIX directory sync; retained copy follows canonical success.

known_limits: Full fixed/adaptive solver restart ownership remains WP02-C.
Full arc-length restart migration remains WP02-D.
Frictional contact state persistence is not implemented or claimed.
Checkpoint persistence is single-process; PETSc/MPI restart is out of scope.
